steps.instruction: Mix 4 cups mandarin oranges, 2 cans pineapple and 2 cups grapes in a large bowl.
Fold in 3 cups of whipped cream and 1 cup of sour cream.
Fold in 6 to 8 cups of miniature marshmallows.
Chill for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Chill for at least 1 hour.

steps.instruction: Stir again before serving.

any-days-a-picnic-chicken-salad.title: Any Day's a Picnic Chicken Salad

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service, A Family Living Program

steps.instruction: Put 2 1/2 cups of diced cooked chicken breast in a large bowl.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped celery and 1/4 cup of chopped onion.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of pickle relish and 1/2 cup of light mayonnaise.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate until ready to serve. Use within 1 to two days. Chicken salad does not freeze well.

ingredients.name: shiitake mushroom caps, rinsed and sliced (or dried shiitake mushrooms)
scallions, green onions, rinsed and chopped
salmon fillet, cut into 4 portions (3 ounces each)

steps.instruction: Put 1 cup of low-sodium chicken broth in a large, shallow sauté pan.
Add 1/2 cup of sliced shiitake mushroom caps and 2 tablespoons of minced ginger.
Add 1/4 cup of chopped scallions and 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce.
Add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil if you like.
Bring the pan to a boil over high heat.
Lower the heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for 2 to three minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 4 portions of salmon fillet, 3 ounces each.
Cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid.
Cook gently over low heat until the salmon flakes easily with a fork.
steps.spoken: Cook gently over low heat for 4 to five minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part. A thermometer should read at least 145 °F.

steps.instruction: Serve 1 piece of salmon with 1/4 cup of broth.
Scoop the flesh out of 2 to 3 avocados, leaving the peel and pit.
Mash the avocado with 1 teaspoon of lemon juice, paprika and salt to taste.
Let the relish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
steps.spoken: Let the relish rest for 5 to ten minutes before serving.

ingredients.name: whole wheat flour tortillas, 10 inches across

steps.instruction: Heat the oven or toaster oven to 400 °F.
Lightly grease a baking sheet with cooking oil spray.
Cut the 3 tortillas into 8 pieces each, like a pizza.
Place the tortilla pieces on the baking sheet.
Spray the tops of the tortilla pieces with cooking oil spray.
Lightly sprinkle with 1 dash of salt, if you like.
Bake for 10 minutes, until crisp and light brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 minutes, until crisp and light brown. Watch closely so the chips do not burn.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Choices: Steps Toward Health, Adapted from: Lisa's Famous Dessert, University of Massachusetts, Extension Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: instant pudding mix, 3.4 ounces, banana or vanilla

steps.instruction: Combine 2 cups of milk and 1 box of pudding mix in a medium bowl.
Beat the pudding on the lowest speed for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Beat the pudding for 2 minutes with a wooden spoon, a wire whisk, or an electric mixer on its lowest speed.

steps.instruction: Gently mix 8 ounces of yogurt into the pudding.
Refrigerate the pudding for 30 minutes.
Layer the banana slices in the bottom of 8 dessert cups.
Pour the pudding mixture over the banana slices.
Top with more banana slices.
Refrigerate for at least 5 minutes before serving.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate for at least 5 minutes before serving. It tastes better if it is refrigerated longer.

black-eyed-pea-and-collard-greens-soup.title: Black-Eyed Pea and Collard Greens Soup

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eating Smart, Being Active, Colorado State University Extension

ingredients.name: collard greens, stems removed and chopped
low-sodium broth, 14.5 ounces, chicken or vegetable

steps.instruction: Wash the collard greens.
Drain and rinse the black-eyed peas.
Place the oil, onion, garlic powder and ham in a large pot over medium heat.
steps.spoken: Place 1 tablespoon of oil, the onion, 1/8 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1/4 pound of ham in a large pot with a lid over medium heat. Stir now and then for 3 to five minutes, until the onion is clear.

steps.instruction: Add 3 cups of collard greens and 1 can of broth to the pot.
Cover the pot and simmer for 20 minutes, until the collard greens are tender.
steps.spoken: Cover the pot and simmer for about 20 minutes, until the collard greens are tender.

steps.instruction: Mash half of the black-eyed peas with a fork in a small bowl.
Stir the mashed peas and the whole peas into the soup.
Simmer the soup for another 5 minutes.
Taste, then add a little salt and black pepper if you like.
Stir in 2 teaspoons of apple cider vinegar just before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers within two hours.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate leftovers within two hours. Eat them within 3 to five days.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Chickasaw Nation Nutrition Services, Get Fresh Initiative

steps.instruction: Mix 3/4 cup of blue cornmeal and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a large bowl.
Stir in 1 cup of boiling water until the ingredients are wet.
Cover the bowl and let it stand for 3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix 1/2 cup milk, 2 tablespoons melted margarine and 1 egg.
Add the milk mixture to the cornmeal mixture.
Add 3/4 cup of flour and 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Mix until combined.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Spray the skillet with cooking spray.
Spoon 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet.
When bubbles appear, flip the pancake.
Cook the other side until golden brown.
Add 1 package of frozen broccoli and 1/4 cup of water to a 10 inch nonstick skillet.
If you like, add 1 small diced carrot.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, until tender, stirring to break up the broccoli.
Drain the broccoli mixture well.
Beat 8 eggs and 1/4 cup of milk in a large bowl.
Beat in 2 teaspoons of mustard, 1 teaspoon of seasoned salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Add the broccoli mixture and 3/4 cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Add 1 tablespoon of chopped green onion and mix well.
Coat the same skillet with cooking spray.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet.
Heat over medium heat for 8 minutes, until the eggs are almost set.
steps.spoken: Heat over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until the eggs are almost set.

steps.instruction: Take the skillet off the heat.
Cover the skillet and let it stand for 8 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the skillet and let it stand for 8 to 10 minutes, until the eggs are completely set and no liquid egg remains.

steps.instruction: Cut the frittata into wedges.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Quick and Healthy Meals: Tips and Tools for Planning Meals for Your Family, Ohio State University Cooperative Extension, Cuyahoga County

ingredients.name: condensed cream of mushroom soup, reduced sodium, 10.75 ounce (or reduced sodium chicken, celery, or cheese soup)
frozen broccoli or cauliflower or mixed vegetables, chopped

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F and grease a 12x9x2 inch baking pan.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of rice, salt and 3 cups of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and set it aside for 15 more minutes.
Sauté 1 chopped onion in 3 tablespoons of margarine until tender.
Mix 1 can of soup, 1 1/2 cups of milk and 1/2 cup of water.
Mix in the onions and the rice.
Spoon the mixture into the baking pan.
Thaw and drain 7 1/2 cups of frozen vegetables.
Spread the vegetables over the rice mixture.
Spread 8 ounces of grated cheese evenly over the top.
Bake for 25 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the rice is bubbly.
steps.spoken: Bake for 25 to thirty minutes, until the cheese is melted and the rice is bubbly.

steps.instruction: Cut the calamansi in half with a sharp knife.
Squeeze the juice from the calamansi with your hands.
Pour the juice into a glass with 1 cup of cold water.
Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of granulated sugar until it dissolves.
Add ice cubes if you like.

ingredients.name: ham bone, or a rough equivalent of salt bacon

steps.instruction: Wash 1 pound of dry pinto beans carefully.
Soak the beans overnight in 8 cups of water.
Drain the beans and add 5 cups of water.
Add 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of ground black pepper.
Add 1 ham bone, or a rough equivalent of salt bacon.
Add 1 to 2 bay leaves.
Add 3 ounces of that day's brewed coffee, if you like.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Simmer the beans for 1 hour, until they are tender.
steps.spoken: Simmer the beans for at least 1 hour, or until they are tender.

steps.instruction: Take out the bay leaves.
Do not drain the beans before serving.
steps.spoken: Do not drain the beans before serving. The liquid is an important part of the dish.

steps.instruction: Serve with a slotted spoon, or ladle into small bowls.
Crush 1 garlic clove with the side of a knife blade.
Put the whole garlic clove in a mixing bowl.
steps.spoken: Put the crushed garlic clove in a mixing bowl. Leave it in one piece.

steps.instruction: Add 1 cup of champagne vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and 1 pinch of salt.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of champagne vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon of freshly ground black pepper and 1 pinch of salt. Let it sit for 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Remove and throw away the garlic.
Whisk in 2 teaspoons of Dijon mustard.
Slowly add 2 cups of extra virgin olive oil, whisking constantly.
steps.spoken: Slowly add 2 cups of extra virgin olive oil, whisking constantly, so it blends smoothly into the dressing.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Add 1/2 pound of bacon, in bite-sized pieces, to a large pot.
Add 1 pound of ground chuck and 1 large chopped onion.
Brown the bacon, ground chuck and onion.
Stir in 2 cloves of minced garlic.
steps.spoken: Stir in the remaining ingredients in order, one at a time, and mix well after each one. First, 2 cloves of minced garlic.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/3 cup of brown sugar.
Stir in 1/3 cup of white sugar.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of molasses.
Stir in 1/4 cup of barbecue sauce.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of mustard.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder.
Stir in 32 ounces of canned pork and beans.
Bake for 40 minutes, until thickened.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 40 minutes, or until thickened.

ingredients.name: smoked duck breast, skin on, chopped
green cabbage, cut into ribbons, optional

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 smoked duck breast and 1-2 tablespoons olive oil and/or butter to a pot.
steps.spoken: Set a large pot with a lid on low heat. Add 1/2 chopped, skin-on smoked duck breast and 1 to two tablespoons of olive oil, butter, or both.

steps.instruction: Cook on low heat for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook on low heat for 2 minutes. Cook on low heat for a couple of minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala.
Cook the spices for 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Cook the spices for 1 or two minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1 large sliced onion.
steps.spoken: Add 1 large sliced onion. Add the sliced onion and let it cook for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1 small parsnip, cut into thin strips.
steps.spoken: Add 1 small parsnip, cut into thin strips. Add the parsnip and let it sweat, softening in the pot.

steps.instruction: Add 1 large bunch of collard greens, cut into ribbons.
Add 1/2 green cabbage, cut into ribbons, if you are using it.
Add pepper to taste and 2 tablespoons of water.
Cover the pot.
Cook until the greens are wilted and tender to the bite.
Preheat the oven to 425 °F.
Grease a baking sheet.
Mix 4 cups of self-rising flour, 1 tablespoon of soft butter and 1 cup of milk.
Mix in 1/2 cup of water and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Knead the bread on a floured surface.
Put the bread in the oven for 25 minutes.
Lower the oven to 350 °F and bake 5 more minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the oven to 350 °F and bake for 5 to ten more minutes. This makes 15 servings.

ingredients.name: niter kibbeh, regular butter, or oil

steps.instruction: Whisk 1 cup of roasted barley flour and 2 cups of water in a pot until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it is thick like porridge.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, until it is thick like porridge. Keep stirring all the time so lumps do not form.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/4 teaspoon of salt until it is mixed in.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of niter kibbeh, butter or oil, and mix well.
Taste, and add more salt if needed.
Spoon the hot porridge into bowls.
Drizzle with honey or sprinkle with sugar to taste.
Sprinkle on mitmita or berbere spice if you want more heat.
Top with nigella seeds or a sprinkle of cinnamon.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: The Best of La Cocina GOYA: Healthy, Tasty, Affordable Latin Cooking/ Lo Mejor de la Cocina GOYA: Cocina Latina Saludable, Rica y Económica, GOYA Foods

ingredients.name: tomato, cored, seeded and finely chopped
low-sodium adobo seasoning, for the salsa
low-sodium adobo seasoning, for the steak

steps.instruction: Mix 1 large chopped tomato and 1/4 small chopped red onion in a small bowl.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of parsley, 2 teaspoons of olive oil and 2 teaspoons of vinegar.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of minced garlic and 1/4 teaspoon of oregano.
Mix in 1/8 teaspoon of adobo seasoning and 1/8 teaspoon of crushed red pepper.
Cover the bowl.
Refrigerate the salsa for at least 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Refrigerate the salsa for at least 1 hour, or up to two days.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to medium-high.
Sprinkle both sides of 1 pound of skirt steak with 1/8 teaspoon of adobo seasoning.
Place the steak on the hot, greased grill grates.
Cook the steak for about 6 minutes, flipping once.
steps.spoken: Cook, flipping once, until the steak is well browned on both sides and a thermometer reads 145 °F. This takes about 6 minutes for medium-rare.

steps.instruction: Let the steak rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the steak thinly.
Divide the steak evenly among 4 plates.
Top the steak with the salsa.
Chop 1 onion.
Sauté the chopped onion in a pan.
Add 1/2 can of tomatoes.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of paprika, salt and sugar.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of cumin and 1 pinch of turmeric.
Add 1 can of lentils and 1 can of kidney beans, then cook for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 can of lentils and 1 can of kidney beans. Cook everything over medium heat for 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Pick over 48 ounces of dried beans and remove any bad ones.
Put the beans in a pot and cover them with water.
Boil the beans until tender, adding water if needed.
steps.spoken: Boil the beans until tender, adding water if needed. You may soak the beans overnight first to cut the cooking time.

steps.instruction: Drain the beans and mash them the way you like.
Bring 4 cups of vegetable broth to a boil in a separate pot.
Stir in the mashed beans and 2 chopped medium onions.
Stir in 1 cup of water, 22 ounces of seitan and 2 chopped habanero peppers.
Boil for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil for about 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of palm oil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring so it doesn't burn.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of country soda and 1 teaspoon of salt.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of country soda, or 2 pinches of baking soda dissolved in warm water. Then stir in 1 teaspoon of salt, or to taste.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: garlic, minced or pressed (about 2 to 3 cloves)

steps.instruction: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil in a 4-quart saucepan over high heat.
Warm 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add 8 ounces of penne to the boiling water.
steps.spoken: Add the penne and cook it for the shortest time on the package, about 8 minutes.

steps.instruction: Chop 8 ounces of mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
Add the mushrooms to the oil and cook for 5 minutes.
Slice 1/2 cup of onion and mince 1 tablespoon of garlic.
Add the onion and garlic to the mushrooms.
steps.spoken: Add the onion and garlic to the mushrooms. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.instruction: Add 6 tablespoons of red wine and stir to loosen the browned bits.
steps.spoken: Add 6 tablespoons of red wine and stir to loosen the browned bits. Cook and stir to loosen any browned bits from the pan so they mix into the sauce.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of broth, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and 1 teaspoon thyme.
Drain the penne and stir it into the mushroom mixture.
Keep simmering for 3 minutes, until all the moisture is absorbed.
Divide into 4 portions and top each with 1 tablespoon of parmesan cheese.
Bring 2 cups of water and a pinch of salt to a boil.
Stir in 1 cup of old-fashioned oats and turn the heat to medium-low.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let it sit for 2 minutes.
Top with 1 tablespoon of brown sugar and serve.
Mix 1/4 cup of tomato sauce with salt, pepper and other seasonings to taste.
steps.spoken: Mix 1/4 cup of tomato sauce with salt, pepper and other seasonings to taste. Let the flavors blend while you prepare the rest.

steps.instruction: Beat 2 eggs well.
Heat a small skillet sprayed with cooking spray over low heat.
Pour the beaten eggs into the skillet.
Cover the skillet and cook for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the skillet and cook for 3 minutes. The eggs should be almost set.

steps.instruction: Carefully flip the omelet and cook for 1 more minute.
Microwave 2 tablespoons each of mushrooms and peppers for 30 seconds.
Spread the tomato mixture over the omelet.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup of mozzarella cheese over the tomato sauce.
Top the cheese with the hot mushrooms and peppers.
Cover the skillet and cook for 2 more minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the skillet and cook for 2 more minutes, until the cheese is melted.

steps.instruction: Rinse 1 cup of long-grain white rice in a strainer.
Bring 2 cups of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt to a boil in a pot.
Add the rice, stir once, cover, and turn the heat to low.
Turn off the heat and let the rice rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve.

ingredients.name: white vinegar or lemon juice, optional

steps.instruction: Put 1 can (7 ounces) of drained white tuna in a medium bowl.
Stir in 6 tablespoons of mayonnaise and 1 tablespoon of sweet pickle relish.
If you like, stir in 2 tablespoons of white vinegar or lemon juice.
If you like, add 1 cup of shredded cheese and 1 chopped hard-boiled egg.
If you like, season with a pinch of garlic powder, salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: yellow or white onions, sliced into thin strips

steps.instruction: Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add 4 large sliced onions and sauté, stirring, for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 4 large sliced onions and sauté, stirring, for about 15 minutes, or until they begin to brown. Don't cook over high heat, or the outsides will char before the insides have softened and sweetened.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of sugar once the onions are soft and light golden brown.
steps.spoken: When the onions have softened and turned a light golden brown, add 1/2 cup of sugar.

steps.instruction: Keep stirring until the sugar melts and begins to bubble.
Clear a space in the center of the pan.
steps.spoken: As the onions turn a richer brown, clear a space in the center of the pan.

steps.instruction: Pour 1/4 cup of balsamic vinegar onto the hot pan in that space.
Stir the vinegar into the onions until it leaves a syrupy coating.
Turn off the heat.
Stir in 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Let the onions cool.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eating Smart, Being Active, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis

steps.instruction: Pour 1 can (15.5 ounces) of black beans, with their liquid, into a pan.
Add 1 can (15.2 ounces) of drained corn to the pan.
Add 1 can (14.5 ounces) of crushed tomatoes, with their liquid, to the pan.
Add 1 teaspoon of chili powder, or more to taste.
Stir everything together.
Keep stirring over medium heat until the chili is hot all the way through.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Stay Young At Heart

ingredients.name: pineapple, cored, peeled and cut into 8 slices
mangos, peeled, pitted and cut into 8 pieces
bananas, peeled and cut into 8 diagonal pieces

steps.instruction: Put 3/4 cup of water and 1/2 cup of sugar in a saucepan.
Add 2 teaspoons of lemon juice and 1 piece of lemon peel.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of rum or vanilla extract, if you like.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat.
Add the pineapple, mangos and bananas, and cook on very low heat 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add the pineapple slices, mango pieces and banana pieces, and cook on very low heat for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Pour the syrup into a cup and set it aside.
Remove the lemon peel.
Cool the cooked fruit for 2 hours.
Arrange the fruit in a serving dish.
Pour a few teaspoons of syrup over the fruit.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves, if you like.
